body_markdown:
### [Standalone AI agents](https://www.windmill.dev/changelog/standalone-ai-agents)


AI


[v1.821.0](https://github.com/windmill-labs/windmill/releases/tag/v1.821.0)


[Docs](https://www.windmill.dev/docs/core_concepts/ai_agents#standalone-agents)


Saved AI agents are listed on the home page, created from + New, and run or chatted with from their own page without a flow around them. Anyone who can read an agent can run it, operators included, and it runs as them.


#### New features


- A new agent starts with managed memory on, so its page is a chat; turn memory off for an agent only reused in flows.
- An agent runs as the caller, who needs access to its provider resource and to what its tools use.
- POST /api/w/<workspace>/jobs/run/agent/<path> runs a saved agent from the API, and a jobs:run:agents:<path> token scope limits a token to one agent.
